fit_rows.population: all 23,222 canonical games, seasons 2008-2025; every game contributes a goals target and a 5v5 xG target

source_compatibility.commercial_rights: Unresolved; research use only pending permission for commercial use
source_compatibility.historical_xg: MoneyPuck-derived historical feature snapshot v1; original xG release version not versioned in source table
source_compatibility.live_xg: MoneyPuck 2026-27 team game-by-game source; MoneyPuck states its xG model was rebuilt for 2026-27; version mismatch remains an explicit limitation

B3_elo.role: moneyline incumbent and Elo-only score distribution

B7_elo_xg_poisson.features: team attack and defence ratings, home advantage, neutral-site suppression
B7_elo_xg_poisson.fit: ridge Poisson on the canonical game file, 400-day recency half-life, ridge 20
B7_elo_xg_poisson.reason: v1 projected margin sd 0.25 against 2.6 observed; walk-forward pooled Brier 0.2462 for the frozen B5 reference vs 0.2444 for v2 over the 9,147 feature-complete games of 2019-2025
B7_elo_xg_poisson.supersedes: v1 log-xG/log-Elo linear predictor for this arm only; B3 and B5 remain v1

specification.probability_handling: independent Poisson score mass; tied target mass resolved with historical home shootout win rate
specification.regulation_win_probability: not estimated by v1; regulation-only target is not present in frozen training table
specification.target: regulation plus overtime team goals; shootout deciding goal excluded
specification.training_seasons: 2008-09 through 2025-26, feature-complete rows, canonical historical files
